meta.text: Next, the cost model. Job compute costs less per DBU — the Databricks Unit that prices consumption — and you only pay for the duration of the run. All-purpose clusters carry a higher DBU rate because they're meant to be long-lived and shared. SQL warehouses sit on their own billing shape, often serverless, scaled by query concurrency. If you remember only one line here, remember that job clusters are the cheaper rate for scheduled work.
